newsitem.title: FINLAND: Outokumpu wins Australian technology order.
newsitem.headline: Outokumpu wins Australian technology order.

text.p: Finnish metals and mining group Outokumpu Oy said on Monday it had agreed with WMC Resources Ltd to license its blister flash smelting method for the expansion of the Olympic Dam Flash Smelter in South Australia.
Outokumpu did not give the value of the deal which it said also included smelter design and equipment.
"This agreement is a start for further equipment supplies within this smelter project," Outolkumpu said in a statement.
WMC is a major world nickel producer, one of Australia's largest gold producers, and it has extensive interests in copper and uranium, Outokumpu said.
It said WMC has produced copper by the Outokumpu Flash Smelting method since 1988.

"It is planned that the 85,000 tonnes current annual production of copper will increase to 150,000 tonnes by 1999 and WMC is now seeking government approvals to extend this to 200,000 tonnes by 2001," Outokumpu said.
